versions.title: Chongqing & Xinjiang relaunch — bilingual planner
changes: Full itinerary retarget to Chongqing and Xinjiang — city-based itinerary sections instead of Tasmania/Melbourne
简体中文 / English language toggle persisted in sidebar and backups
Checklist grouping by city/region replaces travel-date grouping (dates kept ready in trip countdown for future use)
Maps, budget (CN¥), accommodations, flights seed, tips, and copy aligned for travel in mainland China
New app versioning series starting at 1.0.0; service worker cache id refreshed separately in sw.js

note.en: Exact trip dates will go here once confirmed — countdown and PDF headers will automatically use calendar mode.
note.zh: 确认出发与返程日期后写入此处，倒计时与导出将自动切换为按日期显示。

heroTag.en: Chongqing leg · Xinjiang leg — dates to be added
heroTag.zh: 重庆段 · 新疆段 — 日期待定

heroSub.en: Hotpot megacity nights, karst day trips, then high-plateau trains and desert-edge oases — a two-region arc across southwest and the far west.
heroSub.zh: 山城火锅与不夜霓虹，喀斯特与江湖一日往返；再上高原专列与荒漠绿洲，把中国西线与西北一次性串起来。

routeChongqingCaption.en: Subway-heavy city core plus riverfront walks; slot Wulong or Dazu when legs feel fresh.
routeChongqingCaption.zh: 主城轨交高密度，江畔夜景与爬坡小路并存；腿脚允许时插队武隆或大足石刻。

routeXinjiangCaption.en: Ürümqi staging, Tianshan day, Turpan heat & Karez lore — shuffle days if rails or flights jitter.
routeXinjiangCaption.zh: 以乌鲁木齐休整与吃喝打底，天池一日与吐鲁番干热盆地交替；车次或机票变动可随时对调。

mapXjCaption.en: Ürümqi ↔ Heavenly Lake ↔ Turpan basin with orchard detours.
mapXjCaption.zh: 乌鲁木齐—天山天池—吐鲁番盆地与绿洲走廊。

note.en: Riverfront tiered lanterns — go after dusk.
note.zh: 入夜后层次分明，人流量大需预留步行时间。

note.en: Classic crossing — book timed tickets when busy.
note.zh: 节假日排队久，尽量选择预约时段。
轻轨可达，麻花与茶馆密集的步行街区。

note.en: Nature bridge / gorge day-trip arc from CQ.
note.zh: 大型天坑地缝景区，早出晚归型长途日归。
观景平台拍完可顺路鹅岭步道。

note.en: Depart leg when heading to Xinjiang.
note.zh: 飞往乌鲁木齐或接续高铁时的离渝节点。

note.en: Regional flights, Xinjiang cuisine, altitude acclimatisation.
note.zh: 调整作息与补水，牛羊肉与烤制主食为主。

note.en: Alpine lake day above the forest belt.
note.zh: 山区气温低，备好防风保暖与太阳镜。
昼夜温差大，午间防晒与补水必备。

note.en: Historical ruins paired with orchard stops.
note.zh: 适合与坎儿井、火焰山景区组合安排。
可作航班或列车变动时的缓冲休息日。

title.en: Land in Chongqing · river lights & skyline
title.zh: 抵达重庆 · 江边夜景

meta.en: CKG arrivals · light walking only · hydrate after flying
meta.zh: 抵达江北/市区 · 以轻松漫步为主 · 飞行后多喝水

desc.en: Drop bags, ride the metro uphill, and soak in stacked neighbourhoods above the Yangtze and Jialing rivers. Chongqing humid heat in summer differs from Xinjiang dryness — tune clothing before heading west.
desc.zh: 先放下行李，体验立体交通与江城夜景。重庆的湿热与新疆干旱差别大，行前注意衣物与补水节奏。

desc.en: Metro Line 10 links Jiangbei Airport to central transfers; taxis queue on levelled roads — screenshot your hotel Chinese address.
desc.zh: 10 号线等与出租车都方便；陡坡与立交多，备好酒店的中文地址卡片。

desc.en: Order sesame oil dips to cool spice; yoghurt drinks help newcomers. Hydrate generously.
desc.zh: 油碟可缓和辣感；乳酸菌饮料对新手有用，记得补水。

title.zh: 长江索道 · 展馆 · 夜景

meta.en: Metro + walking stairs · hydrate · sun hat
meta.zh: 轨交+步道爬坡 · 注意补水防晒

desc.en: Touch modern CQ history exhibitions, glide the ropeway across the gorge, wander Jiefangbei’s crossing towers, finish with lanterns along the gorge-cut cliffs.
desc.zh: 白天了解近代城市变迁，过江索道取景，晚间回到解放碑与临江栈道感受层次灯光。

desc.en: Free entry pockets with river engineering history — quieter weekdays mornings.
desc.zh: 常设展免费预约，侧重江河工程与城市记忆，工作日早晨较安静。

desc.en: Short iconic crossing — expect queues on sunny weekends.
desc.zh: 体验型过江项目，晴朗周末排队明显。

title.zh: 磁器口与茶馆慢游

meta.zh: 轨交接驳 · 陡坡步行

desc.en: Slow commercial old-town lanes for snacks plus optional craft streets; dodge midday heat.
desc.zh: 以小吃与茶楼为主的古镇步行区；午间避开曝晒时段。

desc.en: Share smaller portions of spicy noodles instead of repeat heavy hotpot lunches.
desc.zh: 可用小面酸辣粉等轻量化午餐，避开连续重油火锅午间作战。

title.zh: 武隆喀斯特景区早出晚归

meta.en: Coach or tour day ·  ~280 km circuit · pack rain shell
meta.zh: 长途景区日 · 约280km级往返 · 带薄雨衣

desc.en: Huge natural bridges slot into the Yangtze tributary valleys — sunrise departures beat traffic. Energy heavy; recuperate afterward.
desc.zh: 大型天坑地缝景区耗能高；建议早出，回程早点休息以备进疆。

desc.en: Book ahead on busy domestic holidays; carry ID matching reservation.
desc.zh: 旺季务必提前预约；证件需与订单一致。

title.en: Mountain city layers · parks above fog
title.zh: 立体交通 · 观景台

meta.zh: 电梯与步道结合 · 短小爬升

desc.en: Peek the train-through-building platforms, ascend viewing decks, savour one last chilli aromatherapy before Xinjiang dryness.
desc.zh: 打卡轨道穿梭楼体的城市剖面，再上观景平台俯视雾都，为进疆的干热气候做准备。

title.en: Fly Ürümqi · reset clocks · lighter dinner
title.zh: 飞乌鲁木齐 · 时差适应 · 清淡晚餐

meta.en: Flight block · airport security early · hydrate cabin
meta.zh: 航班日 · 提前到机场 · 机舱补水

desc.en: Expect longer security queues at mega hubs; Xinjiang gateways may add extra luggage screening — patience + portable snacks.
desc.zh: 大型枢纽安检耗时；进疆航道常见额外行李检查环节，备好零食与水。

desc.en: Lip balm, lotion, and saline nasal spray outperform fancy serums overnight.
desc.zh: 润唇膏与鼻腔盐水喷雾比花哨护肤品更实用。

title.zh: 初入新疆 · 巴扎夜市

meta.en: Urban day · taxis cheap · bilingual maps helpful
meta.zh: 城市日 · 打车不贵 · 离线地图备好

desc.en: Walk the Grand Bazaar fringes after sunset for music and grills without overcommitting the first jet-lagged evening.
desc.zh: 到达当晚以轻松夜游为主，逛逛大巴扎周边的烟火气即可，不宜安排远程车程。

title.zh: 景区车+徒步 · 加一件外套

meta.en: Shuttle queues · ID checks · refill water
meta.zh: 区间车排队 · 证件随身 · 备水

desc.en: Forest-lined shuttle climb to cobalt water — midday UV strong even when air feels cool.
desc.zh: 森林上下的区间车与高海拔湖的紫外线强强组合，体感凉也要防晒。

title.zh: 疆史常设 · 公园日落

desc.en: Alternate heavy walking with conditioned museum halls; perfect for dusty-wind contingency plans.
desc.zh: 若扬尘或大风沙尘预警，可把户外行程调换到展馆类室内。

title.zh: 干热盆地 · 遮阴遗址

meta.en: Ride ~1h tier train · brim hat essential
meta.zh: 动车约一小时级 · 宽檐帽必需

desc.en: Karez underground channels stay surprisingly cool midday — weave them between sun-exposed ridges.
desc.zh: 坎儿井地下渠道中午相对凉爽，可与暴晒地表点穿插安排。

title.zh: 上午果园 · 下午遗址

meta.zh: 甜瓜果切 + 咸味奶茶补水节奏

desc.en: Ride electric carts inside scenic loops; negotiate photo stops politely with growers.
desc.zh: 景区内电瓶车省时，与种植户沟通再进行采摘或拍照更可愉快。

title.zh: 灵活车次 · 补给

desc.en: Use buffer day for SIM top-up, meds, parcel gifts — Ürümqi courier counters cluster near rail hubs.
desc.zh: 缓冲整理日：可处理流量卡、常备药与当地伴手礼快递。

title.en: Either meadow picnic or hammam unwind
title.zh: 草甸野餐式轻松 / 休整

desc.en: Book ride-share groups if meadows interest you; alternatively pool day at hotel sauna to detox spice oils from Chongqing week.
desc.zh: 若不去远郊可酒店休整与桑拿排汗，给身体代谢重庆火锅残留。

title.en: Morning flight CQ or home pivot
title.zh: 早间航班接驳重庆或回原居地

meta.zh: 注意液体托运 · 干果手信

desc.en: Photocopy itineraries for security questions; souvenir knives stay in checked bags only.
desc.zh: 安检问询时行程单打印件更顺滑；刀刃类纪念品务必托运。

sub.en: Flights/rail still floating — grab anchors first.
sub.zh: 票务尚未锁死，先把骨架构住。

title.zh: 锁定进重庆的航班或高铁

detail.en: Flying via CAN/SHA/PEK all work — optimise for midday CKG arrival.
detail.zh: 经广州/上海/首都等枢纽均可—尽量中午前落地江北以便入城。

where.zh: 携程 · 航司App · 里程票

title.zh: 锁重庆⇄乌鲁木齐航线

detail.en: Baggage rules differ — confirm ski gear if planning winter detour.
detail.zh: 行李限额差别大——若冬季绕路滑雪需提早票规。

sub.en: Hot hotels + drivers once dates firm.
sub.zh: 日期敲定后尽早锁房与包车。

title.zh: 解放碑整套民宿/公寓

detail.en: Need elevator + humidifier asks in notes.
detail.zh: 下单备注加湿与电梯需求。

where.zh: 携程民宿 · Airbnb国内房源

title.zh: 新疆包车日报价

detail.en: Government-plated tourism vans required in some prefectures.
detail.zh: 部分地区需营运资质车辆，聊天记录里写明线路。

where.zh: 酒店礼宾 · 点评包车标签

title.zh: 含医疗转运的旅游险

detail.en: Declare hotpot mishaps joking aside — dehydration IVs happen.
detail.zh: 别忽视急性肠胃炎脱水就诊场景。

title.zh: 重复PDF与离线地图包

detail.en: AirDrop copies to buddies — WeChat compression kills photos clarity.
detail.zh: 隔空投送备份给朋友，微信群传图易被压缩。

est.zh: 使用本应用的 PDF 导出

where.zh: 本应用 PDF · Maps.me离线层

item.en: Intl / domestic flights into CQ + return from Xinjiang (placeholder)
item.zh: 进渝与离疆的国内/跨境机票（占位）

note.en: Peak summer domestic fares swing wildly — stalk alerts 6–8 weeks out.
note.zh: 暑期票价波动极大，提前6–8周盯票与里程兑换。

note.en: Wide-body sometimes appears on ultra-busy days.
note.zh: 旺季偶见宽体执飞，关注航司换季表。

note.en: Splurge nights at lake-view Ürümqi towers optional.
note.zh: 可看天山轮廓的高层酒店每晚加价明显。

item.zh: 租车/包车段 + 动车 + 轨交充值

note.en: Xinjiang distances punish one-way taxis — bundle driver days.
note.zh: 远距离建议打包包车日，比单程打车省钱。

note.en: Government-run parks publish seasonal bundles online.
note.zh: 官方渠道常有季节联票。

item.zh: 流量卡常备药纪念品备用金

note.en: Rounded to sweet ¥ totals for chatting in WeChat splits.
note.zh: 方便微信群AA凑整的人民币口径。

title.zh: 证件与通行节奏

items.en: Keep passports + photocopies segmented in waterproof pouches.
items.zh: 护照与复印件分袋防水收纳。

items.en: Domestic checkpoints love printed itineraries — stash PDF exports from this planner.
items.zh: 部分查验更认纸质行程，善用本页的 PDF 导出。

items.en: Alternate heavy outdoor days whenever AQI spikes.
items.zh: 沙尘或重污染天气灵活调换室内外行程。

title.zh: 通讯与离线

items.en: Grab a mainland SIM with generous data — mapping traffic layers update live.
items.zh: 办一张大流量套餐，路况图层实时更新非常关键。

items.en: Offline map packs both CQ’s vertical blocks and Xinjiang motorway spurs.
items.zh: 离线城市包需同时缓存重庆立交与新疆国道支路。

items.en: Power banks >22k mAh occasionally blocked at tighter airports — carry two midsize packs.
items.zh: 超规充电宝偶被拦下，分拆两只中等容量更安全。

title.zh: 口味过渡

items.en: Ease chilli transition with yoghurt drinks before jumping into Xinjiang lamb feasts.
items.zh: 进入新疆羊肉串大餐前先用酸奶饮品过渡肠胃。

items.en: Carry peppermint oil for windy bus hops — scents calm motion upsets.
items.zh: 长途盘山巴士可随身薄荷油提神防晕。

loc.en: Yuzhong core — walkable to ropeway & Hongyadong
loc.zh: 渝中核心区，步行可达索道与洪崖洞

tip.en: Pick properties with lift access after midnight hotpot — stairs-only walk-ups hurt after ropeway queues.
tip.zh: 深夜火锅归来尽量选有电梯房源，纯楼梯房在排队索道日后会很累。

nights.zh: 1 晚 · 喀斯特日后缓冲

tip.en: Book flexible cancellation — weather can sock-in the gorge photos you came for.
tip.zh: 建议选可免费取消的房型，山区起雾时景观波动大。

tip.en: Central heating in winter floors can feel dry — ask for humidifier if provided.
tip.zh: 冬季集中供暖偏干，可向前台争取加湿器。

tip.en: Courtyard fountains beat rooftop-only AC when midday hits 40°C+.
tip.zh: 午间40°C以上时带喷泉的内院休憩优于纯空调顶楼。
